findings.title: Native After return cannot serve as the mount refresh pending latch
findings.proposal: Explicit pending flag before After; clear on delivery and preserve current combat deferral. Consider the separate half-second refresh burst independently.
findings.addonWideMechanism: Same void-After ownership mechanism as other round-2 call sites; do not count every call site as a separate mechanism.

findings.classification: confirmed active call budget; no native CPU timing
findings.title: Vendor detection re-enumerates the full mount journal on every full mount refresh
findings.proposal: Reuse the existing collection cache/owner with explicit collection/readiness invalidation and preserve vendor priority and late metadata completion.

findings.classification: confirmed active name-dependent logic; synthetic localized provider name
findings.title: Vendor mount recognition depends on English native display names
findings.proposal: Verify stable per-client vendor mount/spell identities, use native localized output and retain existing saved assignments. Do not use the dormant duplicate-key ID table as verified data.

findings.title: Disabled pre-DF reticle VFX still searches all shown face owners every tick
findings.evidence: reticle_disabled.lua.txt; real Overlay disabled guard and complete Cast fixture
findings.proposal: Retain necessary targeting/cancel observation but skip optional owner/face matching while rendering is disabled. Test checked-state lifecycle and re-enable during targeting.

findings.title: Numeric cooldown signature commits despite failed native setter
findings.proposal: Commit signatures only after accepted native operations; retry through the existing paint cycle and keep successful unchanged timers at one write.
findings.gate: Capture a real native failure with legal public args before attributing current user errors to this robustness case.

findings.classification: reproduced dormant legacy helper defect; no demonstrated current TOC consumer
findings.title: Literal percent-bracket search disables legacy active macro-clause selection
findings.evidence: ebs_round2.lua.txt; complete dormant module and isolated in-memory typo control
findings.proposal: Correct the two literal searches only if legacy helper support is retained. Establish a current caller before promoting this to an active feature fix.
